expects.query:
Deploy the VSS **lvs** profile on `{{platform}}` via `/vss-deploy-profile -p lvs`. Run autonomously.

**Environment and required setup:** Deploy a **full-remote VSS lvs profile** (deploy mode = `remote-all`; the agent's LLM and the VLM called by the video summarization service use remote launchpad endpoints, with no local NIMs). Run on ONE `RTXPRO6000BW` host with `gpu_count: 1`. After deployment, download and extract the exact NGC sample required by the following summarization task: `nvidia/vss-developer/dev-profile-sample-data:3.2.0`. Confirm `/tmp/vss-sample-data/dev-profile-sample-data/warehouse_sample.mp4` exists. Do not substitute `/data/videos/cam_*.mp4`, calibration fixtures, or another warehouse-looking file. The summarization task will upload this exact file through VIOS if needed and immediately consume a fresh clip URL, so do not create or persist a temporary media URL here.

Then prepare the host CLI the summarization task will use. Set `VSS_REPO_ROOT="${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}"`, validate that `services/agent/pyproject.toml` exists under it, and run `cd "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}" && uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss summarize run --help`. Record the deployment with `vss configure --base-url http://localhost:7777` — the HAProxy ingress origin, never the LVS container port 38111, which routes no Elasticsearch — then inspect `vss configure show` and require that it lists both an `lvs` service and an `elasticsearch` service: summarization needs the first and memory persistence the second.

Required services: video summarization at http://localhost:38111/v1/ready (HTTP 200; retry only 503 warmup), VIOS at http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1, and the VSS Agent at http://localhost:8000/docs.
checks: `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8000/docs` returns exit 0 (Agent REST API responsive)
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:38111/v1/ready` returns exit 0 (video summarization API ready)
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-agent` returns exit 0
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx redis` returns exit 0
`test -s /tmp/vss-sample-data/dev-profile-sample-data/warehouse_sample.mp4` returns exit 0

The project-local CLI is usable from the validated checkout: `cd "${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}" && uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss summarize run --help` returns exit 0. The `--extra cli` flag is required; a globally installed `vss` is not an acceptable substitute

The agent recorded the deployment against the ingress origin `http://localhost:7777` rather than the LVS container port `:38111`, and the recorded configuration reports both an `lvs` service and an `elasticsearch` service. Verify by running `vss configure show` from the validated checkout and inspecting the reported services

expects.query:
Invoke and follow the vss-summarize-video skill for this summarization operation. Summarize `warehouse_sample.mp4` with scenario 'warehouse monitoring' and events ['boxes falling', 'forklift stuck', 'person entering restricted area']. First make the video available through VIOS: check whether it is already present, upload the exact source file `/tmp/vss-sample-data/dev-profile-sample-data/warehouse_sample.mp4` only if it is absent, and resolve a fresh clip URL covering the existing or newly uploaded video's full timeline. Verify that URL is fetchable from `vss-lvs`.

Then make exactly one `vss summarize run` invocation, through the project-local CLI from the validated checkout, passing that fresh URL with `--url`, the resolved VIOS sensor id with `--video-id`, the scenario with `--scenario`, each event with its own `--event`, `--chunk-duration 10`, and the media start `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z` with `--creation-time` so the persisted event times are absolute instants. Rely on the deployment recorded by `vss configure`: pass no endpoint, index, or model flag, and do not hand-roll a `POST /v1/summarize` with curl or python. Do not reuse a previously generated clip URL or substitute another file.

Any completed run is terminal, including one whose summary or events are empty: report it and stop without re-running the job, changing deployment configuration, restarting services, extracting frames, or calling VLM/RT-VLM inference endpoints directly. Finally, read the `job_id` and the `persist` object from the run's completion marker, and report the summary, every returned event, and that job id. Do not read the record back to prove the write landed: the marker already reports it, and recalling memory is a different skill's job.
checks: The agent issues exactly one `vss summarize run` operation — not zero, not two, and no retries or parallel hedging. Start from canonical steps[].tool_calls entries deduplicated by tool_call_id, ignore duplicated command text under extra/raw_arguments, observations, or messages, and inspect each canonical command for multiple invocations, loops, or scripts that could run it more than once. A completed run is terminal; diagnostics may read the saved stdout or use non-mutating GET/log inspection but must not issue another summarize run

The agent never hand-rolls the summarization request: the canonical command stream contains no curl, wget, python, or httpx POST to `/v1/summarize` or `/summarize` on any host or port, because the CLI owns that request

Before summarizing, the agent reuses warehouse_sample.mp4 when already present in VIOS or uploads the exact source file /tmp/vss-sample-data/dev-profile-sample-data/warehouse_sample.mp4 when absent, then resolves a fresh full-timeline clip URL that is fetchable from vss-lvs

The summarize invocation runs the project-local CLI from the validated checkout — `uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss summarize run` — and not through `docker exec`, `kubectl exec`, a container or pod shell, or a globally installed `vss`

The invocation passes `--url` exactly equal to the fresh VIOS clip URL resolved earlier in this same step, identifying warehouse_sample rather than a cam_00 or calibration fixture; `--video-id` set to that recording's VIOS sensor id — taken from `sensor/list` when the video was already present, or from the `sensorId` the upload returned, rather than from a stream id; `--scenario` exactly 'warehouse monitoring'; three separate `--event` flags carrying the three user-supplied strings verbatim; `--chunk-duration 10`; and `--creation-time 2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

The invocation passes no `--object-of-interest` (none were requested), no `--model`, and no endpoint, index, base-url, or deployment flag — it relies on what `vss configure` recorded. It also does not pass `--no-persist`, so the summary is persisted to unified memory

The run exits 0 and its final stdout line is a single compact JSON object carrying a `job_id` that starts with `summarize-`, plus a `persist` object whose status is `complete`. The agent uses that exact job_id afterwards rather than inventing or reformatting one

In the run's stdout payload, the LVS envelope is nested under `summary`: parsing `summary.choices[0].message.content` as JSON yields an object with fields {video_summary, events}, where video_summary is a string and events is an array. Empty values are valid for this custom-label step because the eval has no ground-truth guarantee that warehouse_sample contains any of the three requested events

The agent never reports an absence it did not confirm. This check is conditional: if the parsed content has a non-empty `video_summary` or at least one event, it does not apply — mark it PASS without looking for any further field. Only when both are empty does it apply, and then the agent must read `summary.usage.total_chunks_processed` from the same payload and report whether processing was confirmed, treating a positive integer as confirmation and zero or a missing field as unconfirmed, never as 'no detections'

The `persist` object in that same marker accounts for what was written: its `events` count equals the number of entries in the parsed `summary.choices[0].message.content.events` array, so a run that returned events did not persist zero of them

After a run that exits 0, the agent does not verify the write by reading it back: no `vss summarize get`, `vss summarize list`, or `vss summarize status` for the job it just created, and no direct Elasticsearch query. The marker's `persist` object is the evidence, and recalling memory belongs to a separate skill. Reconciling an unknown outcome after a timeout is a different case and is not what this check forbids

The agent renders the video_summary value faithfully in its final reply and reports the job id; when the summary is empty, the agent explicitly reports that the service returned an empty summary rather than inventing content

The agent renders every event returned by the video summarization service, if any, preserving each description field in full; when events is empty, it explicitly reports that no requested events were returned
The agent never calls a VLM or RT-VLM inference endpoint directly, including POST /v1/chat/completions or /v1/generate_captions, and never performs extracted-frame inference
